flows.title: Create a base
steps: Select the workspace for the base.
Select one of the options offered, such as Build an app on your own, or Build an app with Omni.

flows.title: Duplicate a base
steps: On your Airtable home screen, search for and open the base.
Click the ˅ icon next to the base's name.
Select the ... icon, then click Duplicate base.
In the window that opens, choose the record and comment settings, then click Duplicate base.

flows.title: Download a table as a CSV
steps: On your Airtable home screen, open the base with the table.
Click the ˅ icon next to the view's name. The download is per view, and the view's filters can leave records out of the file.
Click Download CSV. The file is saved to the computer; look in the Downloads or Recents folder.
